description: Returns one random Star Wars entity of the given resource type as a JSON object. Each call can return a different entity, so it is not idempotent. Useful for demos and quizzes; to fetch a specific entity use sw_search or sw_get.

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.

name: sw_random
